KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Ushairi 3.2.1 Uchambuzi wa Mashairi ● Maudhui ● Dhamira, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Ushairi 3.2.1 Uchambuzi wa Mashairi ● Maudhui ● Dhamira.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Ushairi 3.2.1 Uchambuzi wa Mashairi ● Maudhui ● Dhamira.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ushairi 3.2.1 Uchambuzi wa Mashairi ● Maudhui ● Dhamira.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Ushairi 3.2.1 Uchambuzi wa Mashairi ● Maudhui ● Dhamira.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. mitoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. zito
   D. fupi

4. When practising Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi ● Hekaya ● Hurafa, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi ● Hekaya ● Hurafa.

5. When practising Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia 2.3.1 Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia ● Maudhui ● Dhamira ●, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia 2.3.1 Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia ● Maudhui ● Dhamira ●.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia 2.3.1 Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia ● Maudhui ● Dhamira ●.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia 2.3.1 Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia ● Maudhui ● Dhamira ●.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 3.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Semi.

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
